source.notes: Current native Backdrop resolves BACKGROUND_SCRIM. The override is visible only where the dim layer is exposed.

privacy.notes: Full images show fictional guild and channel labels, server description and generic icon. No account or message content appears.

annotation.notes: Outline marks the dimming layer above the sheet without covering its title or contents.
